answer: Sybil defence starts where capital stops working. Holding tokens buys no standing; only graded work on the ridge accrues. Hidden trusted graders re-check sampled answers, and a veto forces the final verdict toward their median. An attacker cannot see which lane samples which answer, so the zenith of buying votes must cover the whole panel rather than one seat. What cannot be bought is a jury that already trusts you. Each dune has to be earned inside a panel system that prices collusion at the loss of every seat granted. Seal 1fbev.
